page.overview:
Who is Captain Falcon?

Captain Falcon is a playable character in the Super Smash Bros. series. He is from the F-Zero racing series and is one of the "Original 12".

Captain Falcon is a tall man that is often seen wearing blue or purple racing clothes. He also wears a red helmet with goggles.

Captain Falcon hails from Port Town where he races in his signature machine, the Blue Falcon. With it, he has won numerous races and has defeated the villainous Black Shadow. His appearances in the Super Smash Bros. series has helped to boost his public image. Captain Falcon's appearance in the original Super Smash Bros. took audiences by surprise, though his inclusion was massively applauded due to both his original fighting style and his voice. This paved the way for Captain Falcon reappearing in all subsequent Smash installments. As of now, Captain Falcon is more or less a mainstream character of gaming culture rather than being a curious character known only to the devoted Nintendo fandom.

Captain Falcon has appeared in the Smash Bros. series from the first installment, beginning as his incarnation from F-Zero X. He is an unlockable fighter, and his unlocking condition is for the player to complete the One-Player mode within 20 minutes, and defeat him in a match to earn him.
